title: WF03 XC-02..XC-06 testfix diagnosis: mixed integration-schema drift and test expectation drift across XC suites
summary: WF-03 diagnosis identified mixed schema and test drift across XC suites. Rework 02c resolved the XC-03/XC-04/XC-05/XC-06 blocker cluster by updating integration fixtures to current contracts and adding targeted compatibility shims in integration test harness.

root_cause.details: Current XC integration tests were authored against assumptions that do not align with the present migration state and DB contracts. The largest hard blocker is XC-03 where repository schema expectations conflict with existing REPO migrations; additional clusters are dominated by test SQL expectations that do not match current tables/constraints and deterministic ordering semantics.

changes: Rework A (tests): align xc02/xc04/xc05/xc06 integration assertions and fixtures to current schema contracts and deterministic ordering rules.
Rework B (source+migration): reconcile XC-03 repository schema/activation path with migration history via forward migration and minimal loader/repository implementation updates.
Re-run focused suites per cluster before aggregate integration rerun.

prevention: When introducing new cross-cutting integration suites, validate inserts/queries against current migration reality before finalizing tests.
Avoid ordering assertions that rely on insertion order when query order is timestamp+UUID with same-timestamp writes.
Treat schema shape transitions as forward migrations; do not rely on retroactive edits to already-applied migrations.
